title: Who's Been Sleeping in My Bed?
description: A psychoanalyst's secretary (Carol Burnett) arranges a fake marriage for her friend (Elizabeth Montgomery) to make a TV star (Dean Martin) jealous.

title: My Fair Lady
description: Oscar-winning adaptation of the Broadway hit about an English professor (Rex Harrison) who teaches a cockney merchant (Audrey Hepburn) to be a lady.

title: Lili
description: A French teen (Leslie Caron) joins a carnival and meets a lying magician (Jean-Pierre Aumont) and a loving puppeteer (Mel Ferrer).

title: Andy Hardy Meets Debutante
description: Andy (Mickey Rooney) goes to New York with the judge (Lewis Stone) and tries, through another girl (Judy Garland), to meet a debutante.

title: Andy Hardy's Private Secretary
description: Andy's (Mickey Rooney) so busy with his secretary (Kathryn Grayson) planning the high-school graduation that he flunks a final.

title: Hail the Conquering Hero
description: Preston Sturges' satire about a sickly soldier discharged from duty and mistaken for a war hero when he returns home.

title: The Great McGinty
description: A dimwitted drifter finds his values changing after he is manipulated into becoming a successful public official.

title: Christmas in July
description: A penniless office worker goes on a spending spree after fellow workers trick him into believing he has won a contest.

title: The Palm Beach Story
description: An inventor's (Joel McCrea) wife (Claudette Colbert) meets some sporting millionaires on a train to Florida.

title: The Lady Eve
description: Father-daughter cardsharps (Barbara Stanwyck, Charles Coburn) fleece a rich man's son (Henry Fonda) on a cruise ship.

title: Sullivan's Travels
description: A Hollywood director's desire to produce a film about real people and human suffering leads him on an odyssey as a hobo.

title: The First Five Minutes: The Title Design Legacy of Dan Perri
description: Designer Dan Perri details his life, creative career and title sequence work for some of the most influential and widely recognized films in cinematic history.

title: Airplane!
description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

title: Taxi Driver
description: A disturbed New York cabby (Robert De Niro) befriends a teenage hooker (Jodie Foster) and frees her from her pimp.

title: Raging Bull
description: The violent nature of prizefighter Jake LaMotta leads first to a boxing championship, then to a downward spiral of self-destruction.

title: California Split
description: Two compulsive gamblers (George Segal, Elliott Gould) set out on a gambling streak, searching for a big payday. While they have some lucky moments, they also contend with setbacks that threaten to derail their hedonistic betting binge.

title: The Heavenly Body
description: An astronomer's (William Powell) neglected wife (Hedy Lamarr) thinks an air-raid warden (James Craig) is the mystery man her astrologer predicted.

title: Athena
description: A singer and a lawyer (Edmund Purdom) fall for Athena (Jane Powell) and Minerva (Debbie Reynolds), two sisters out of seven named after constellations.

title: Human Beasts
description: A hit man double crosses his yakuza employers and flees with a cache of diamonds, taking refuge with a family who have plans of their own.

title: Adventures of Rusty
description: A boy (Ted Donaldson) gets used to his new stepmother (Margaret Lindsay) and pet, once a vicious police dog.

title: Tom & Jerry
description:
Ventriloquist Cat
A sneaky alley cat uses a ventriloquist device to trick an angry bulldog into believing he is in many different places.

title: The Flea Circus
description: A dog threatens the fortunes of a flea circus.

title: The Muppets Take Manhattan
description: Kermit and company try to take their variety show to Broadway, while Miss Piggy grows jealous of a friendly waitress.

title: On the Town
description: Sailors Gabey (Gene Kelly), Chip (Frank Sinatra) and Ozzie have 24 hours to meet pretty women and see the sights of New York.

title: The Naked City
description: Two New York police detectives chase leads and grill suspects in their relentless search for a playgirl's killer.

title: Ice Station Zebra
description: A U.S. submarine commander (Rock Hudson) races Russians to a North Pole weather station to recover a Soviet spy satellite.

title: The Rose Tattoo
description: Based on the play by Tennessee Williams. A lonely widow rediscovers her earthy side with a robust trucker.

title: La vie en rose
description: French singer Édith Piaf (Marion Cotillard) becomes a national icon but tries to overcome personal problems that began early in her childhood.

title: The Great Flamarion
description: A vaudeville marksman (Erich von Stroheim) accidentally shoots his assistant's (Mary Beth Hughes) husband (Dan Duryea).

title: Born Reckless
description: A blonde and a rodeo star form a team both personally and professionally.

title: Sex Kittens Go to College
description: Thinko the robot picks a stripper (Mamie Van Doren) with a high IQ to head a college science department.

title: Love Is on the Air
description: A newscaster (Ronald Reagan) gets demoted for exposing the town's criminal activities over the airwaves.

title: Hi, Nellie
description: A demoted editor becomes a successful lonely-hearts columnist while working to expose political scandal.

title: The House Across the Street
description: A lowly columnist attempts to reclaim his dignity and his editorial post by tracking down a notorious gangster.

title: The Great Flamarion
description: A vaudeville marksman (Erich von Stroheim) accidentally shoots his assistant's (Mary Beth Hughes) husband (Dan Duryea).

title: The Miracle Worker
description: Teacher Anne Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) leads deaf and blind Helen Keller (Patty Duke) out of darkness.

title: The Yearling
description: A pet deer changes a boy (Claude Jarman Jr.) and his parents (Gregory Peck, Jane Wyman), pioneering farmers in Florida after the Civil War.

title: The Hucksters
description: A World War II veteran (Clark Gable) rejoins Madison Avenue and plays dirty for a ruthless soap tycoon (Sydney Greenstreet).

title: The Long, Long Trailer
description: Newlyweds (Lucille Ball, Desi Arnaz) splurge on a trailer for their honeymoon, which includes Yosemite National Park.

title: Network
description: A TV executive (Faye Dunaway) boosts her ratings with a mad anchorman (Peter Finch) who thinks he speaks for God.

title: Chinatown
description: A 1930s gumshoe named Jake (Jack Nicholson) sticks his nose into a sordid mess over Los Angeles land and water.

title: The Quarterback
description: The Quarterback

title: La Collectionneuse
description: A young man tells himself high ideals are what kept him from sleeping with a temptress staying at the same St. Tropez boarding house.

title: Love in the Afternoon
description: A happily married Frenchman (Bernard Verley) is tempted to be intimate with his kooky afternoon companion (Zouzou).

title: Along the Great Divide
description: A U.S. marshal (Kirk Douglas) leads a lynch-mob survivor, his daughter (Virginia Mayo) and others across the desert to justice.

title: Fort Dobbs
description: A wanted man (Clint Walker) leads a widow (Virginia Mayo) and her son to a fort away from Indians and a gunrunner (Brian Keith).

title: Westbound
description: A Union officer is assigned to start a stagecoach line that will transport California gold to Northern coffers.

title: White Heat
description: A brave federal agent poses as a thug to infiltrate psychopathic hoodlum Cody Jarrett's gang of thieves.

title: Smart Girls Don't Talk
description: The beautiful Linda strikes up a romance with Marty, the seemingly charming owner of a gambling joint. It isn't long before she realizes that he has his hands in more sinister enterprises, including murder.
